overall_summary: The channel's highest-performing content centers on extreme, mind-bending space phenomena, specifically those featuring sensory contradictions or bizarre planetary physics (e.g., 'Planet of Burning Ice' with 1,053 views and 'Largest Ocean in Space' with 460 views). Conversely, abstract psychology and brain-related topics consistently underperform, often struggling to break 50 views. Additionally, uploading duplicate concepts or re-uploading identical shorts within short timeframes (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' and 'Why Space Is Completely Silent') is diluting performance.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet of Burning Ice Will Break Your Brain!' (1,053 views), 'What Does Outer Space Actually Smell Like? (Steak/Space)' (368 views), and 'The Planet Where It Rains Molten Iron!' (213 views and growing rapidly) are the top-performing concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on cosmic anomalies that challenge everyday sensory experiences (smell, temperature, weather) and use high-contrast imagery.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos using 'Will Break Your Brain' or 'Will Mind-Blow You' in the title paired with extreme physical facts average 3x higher views than standard educational titles.
winning_patterns.action: Incorporate cognitive-dissonance framing in the first 3 seconds of the Short to force immediate viewer pause.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' (38 views), 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5 views), and 'The Real Reason Songs Get Stuck In Your Head' (17 views) consistently fail to gain traction.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from generic internal brain/psychology facts unless they can be tied to an extreme, highly visual physical consequence.

weak_patterns.evidence: Uploading 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' twice on the same day split the audience (195 views vs 54 views). 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' also saw split performance.
weak_patterns.action: Maintain a strict 14-day minimum window before revisiting similar concepts, and avoid uploading duplicate video files entirely.
